name: doc_parser
summary: Generic HTML → ParserCursor-shaped JSONL with adapter slots for Godot HTML docs, Blender Python API, Blender Compositor, plus stubs for Substance / Mari / FB Sapiens. Every parsed page becomes a CursorNode stream readable by parser_cursor.ParserCursor verbatim and gets anchored by an InferenceLogger crystal.
engine_pattern: html.parser.HTMLParser → _StructuredHTMLCollector event log → DocAdapter.parse() yields CursorNode → ParserWriter writes JSONL → InferenceLogger.log() emits crystal anchor

adapters.name: godot
adapters.targets: Godot HTML docs (Sphinx stable + synthetic generator pages)
node_types_emitted: section (class / method_group / property_group / signal_group / enum_group / constant_group)
term (method / property / signal / constant / enum / symbol)

adapters.name: blender_py
adapters.targets: Blender bpy Python reference (Sphinx-generated, py method / py function / py class / py attribute / py data)
node_types_emitted: term (method / function / class / property / classmethod / staticmethod / exception)

adapters.name: substance
adapters.targets: Substance Designer / Substance 3D node reference HTML
adapters.notes: Registered placeholder; parse() raises NotImplementedError until an adapter is implemented.

adapters.name: mari
adapters.targets: Foundry Mari project + node reference HTML

adapters.name: fb_sapiens
adapters.targets: Facebook / Meta Sapiens human-mesh model documentation

fallback_walker.name: _generic_walk
fallback_walker.trigger: adapter.matches(html_bytes) returns False OR adapter.parse() yields no nodes OR adapter raises an unexpected exception
node_types_emitted: section / subsection / definition_list / term / definition / code_block / code_inline

storage.node_shape: ParserCursor JSONL — {type, name, data, attributes, parent, depth}

guarantees: Stdlib only — no BeautifulSoup, no lxml, no pip installs
Deterministic — same HTML bytes → same CursorNode order → same JSONL bytes → same crystal hash
Idempotent — re-running parse_html_file wipes the old JSONL before writing
Graceful fallback — adapter mismatch / failure → _generic_walk with _quality:'generic'
Crystal-anchored — InferenceLogger.log() runs per page so the doc corpus joins the master chain
constraints: Does NOT modify parser_cursor.py, cc.sh, or .env
ParserCursor JSONL shape is the only output format (interop with the existing cursor stack)
InferenceLogger failure never breaks a parse (best-effort anchor)
usage_example:
from doc_parser import parse_html_file, ADAPTERS
out = parse_html_file('godot', '/path/to/class_node.html')
# out → studio/assets/_doc_corpus/godot/<crystal>.jsonl
from parser_cursor import ParserCursor, ERR_FILE_EOF
cur = ParserCursor()
cur.open(out)
while cur.read() != ERR_FILE_EOF:
    print(cur.get_node_name(), cur.get_node_data())
